## Goal
Maintain an accurate, up-to-date record of configuration values for a distributed system comprising multiple services (Alder through Velvet, Yarrow) and hosts (Cedar, Iris, Nova, Rune, Zenith, etc.), ensuring precise tracking of maintenance windows, network ports, resource limits (swap, disk, DB pools, build cache), log retention policies, code review SLAs, deployment branches, backup schedules, and special-case overrides across various scopes (production, canary, weekends, hotfixes, frontend squads).

## Constraints & Preferences
- "Large log files should be summarized, not pasted."
- "User wants dates written as YYYY-MM-DD."
- Credentials and secrets must be replaced with [REDACTED].
- Docker commands do not require sudo on this machine.
- Maintenance windows are critical; changes must be validated against existing schedules.
- "Proposal to move Lyra to size of the build cache 134 GB was rejected; it stays 365 GB."

- "Proposal to move Umbra to request timeout 2450 ms was rejected; it stays 6250 ms."
- User reads documentation in English but chats in Korean.
- Prefer small pull requests with clear titles.
- Avoid force-pushing to shared branches.
- Office VPN only works with MTU 4143.
